pages.title: Erratum for SGA 4, volume 3
pages.html:
Erratum for SGA 4, volume 3

XIV p.18 1.14

(XIX 6) instead of (XX 6).

XVI 2.2

One must assume \(F\) locally constant!

XVI 5.2

The proof given is incomplete. After the statement of the induction hypothesis, one must first reduce to the case where \(F\) is constant (\(F\) becomes constant on an étale Galois covering \(\pi:X'\mathchoice{\longrightarrow}{\rightarrow}{\rightarrow}{\rightarrow} X\) of \(X\), with Galois group \(G\), and one invokes the Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence \(E_2^{p q}=\underline{\operatorname{H}}^p(G,\underline{\operatorname{H}}^q(X',\pi^\ast F))\Rightarrow \underline{\operatorname{H}}^{p+q}(X,F)\)). The arguments that follow are then correct.

XVII 1.1.8

The sign (1.1.8.1) is incorrect when \(F\) is contravariant in certain variables. One should read:

\[ \tag{1.1.8.1} \rho^{\underline k} = (-1)^{A(\underline k)}: \text{ automorphism of } F\circ (G_j)\left(K_i^{k_i\varepsilon(i)\varepsilon(\psi(i))}\right) \]

with

\[ A(\underline k) = \sum_{\varepsilon(i) = \varepsilon(\psi(i))=-} k_i + \sum_{\varepsilon(j)=-} \sum_{\substack{\psi(a)=\psi(b)=j \\ a<b}} k_a k_b \]

XVII 2.1.3

The proof contains flagrant errors. One must delete the 3rd line (p.34 1.9) and replace the 6th and 7th (p.34 1.12, 13) by:

The arrows of diagram (2.1.3.2) induce maps

\[ \hom_y(F,F) \mathchoice{\longrightarrow}{\rightarrow}{\rightarrow}{\rightarrow} \hom_{f g'}({g'}^\ast F,f_\ast F) = \hom_{x'}(f'_\ast {g'}^\ast F,g^\ast f_\ast F) \text{,} \]

XVIII 2.14.4

Read XVII 6.2.7.2 instead of XVII 6.2.4.

XVIII p.99 1-1

Read \(u\) instead of \(U\) and 3.1.16.1 instead of 3.1.11.1.
